events.text: Yes hello, I'm calling from the Mesquite Community Bank investigations department regarding suspicious withdrawals.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Two ATM withdrawals in Houston. We believe an employee is involved, so this conversation must stay confidential, tell nobody at your branch.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: We need you to withdraw 4,000 in cash and deposit it at the crypto kiosk I direct you to, so we can trace the thief.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: It's how the federal trace works. Stay on the line with me while you drive.
